schema_gaps: ISO/IEC 21320-1 §4.2 also constrains split/spanned archives (EOCD 'number of this disk' / 'disk where central directory starts' fields must both be zero). ZipSnapshot/ZipEntry retain no disk-number field at all -- ZipEngine::decode_zip already unconditionally rejects any non-zero disk-start with ZipError::UnsupportedMultiDisk before a ZipSnapshot is ever produced, so there is no field left to check post-hoc and no honest way to verify split/spanned-ness from this schema. Skipped per the roster's explicit instruction rather than fabricated; NOT emitted as a runtime schema-gap diagnostic because the rest of ISO/IEC 21320-1 Core IS fully checkable from this schema (encryption/strong-encryption flag bits, data-descriptor bit, version-needed) -- a subset-wide 'unverifiable' diagnostic would itself be dishonest here, unlike PDF 1.4 ✳️a/✳️x's genuinely broad schema gap.
preexisting_breakage_noted: cargo check shows the SAME class of glue.rs-missing error already present for another concurrent W3 unit (s.stdio.step ✳️cc1: 'could not find `cc1` in `subsets`'), confirming this is the expected shared-tree handoff state for this wave, not something introduced by this unit.
